info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Materials-v1-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Materials Retrieval API provides access to educational materials associated with student enrollments. This endpoint allows users to efficiently query and retrieve relevant materials for various educational programs. It is particularly useful for educators, administrators, and developers integrating educational resources into their systems. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their learning platforms with comprehensive resource listings tailored to enrollment details.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch a list of materials associated with student enrollments. It provides an efficient way to access important resources needed for academic programs and courses, facilitating better education planning and resource allocation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve enrollment materials. It expects specific parameters in JSON format that define the query criteria for fetching the materials.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the materials for enrollments.
